proof_requests: Send new photos: (1) console model/serial label sticker, (2) disc slot area (or clear view confirming disc drive presence/absence), (3) storage capacity from Settings, (4) close-up of the controller model/condition.
Send proof of accessories: photos of the “pads” and the UK receipt (with personal info blurred).
Send a short test video: boot + HDMI output + USB port test (plug a USB device) showing detection.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. Without photos/videos showing disc status, storage size, serial/model label, accessory/receipt inclusion, and port testing, the correct Oyo resale price cannot be set reliably.
